name: Open subtitle sample, edit caption and export
description: Checks the useful local editor workflow without requiring an external AI model download.
steps: Inspect language list and choose a language
Click SRT and confirm a subtitle file downloads
Refresh and check the edited caption text is restored
expected: The editor exposes editable captions, subtitle export is available, and text persists after refresh.

name: Empty upload blocks processing
description: Confirms that recognition cannot start without a real file and the mobile layout remains usable.
steps: Open AI-студия on a mobile viewport
Type немец in language search and check German appears as an option
Clear language search and switch to Whisper Base
Select Перевод речи на английский and verify the UI explains that other target languages are not yet supported.
expected: Recognition is disabled without an uploaded media file; language search filters the 99 languages, both model sizes and English translation mode are selectable.

name: Pricing transparently marks checkout unavailable
description: Checks the app explains client-side processing and does not pretend payment works in this beta.
expected: Free beta is clearly available, Cloud Pro is clearly unavailable, and the studio reports on-device processing.

name: Import existing subtitles and export formats
description: A subtitle file can be imported directly without running AI, and is editable and exportable.
steps: Open subtitle import in the studio and select a small valid .srt file with two captions
Verify two captions appear in the editor
Check MP4 button is absent without an uploaded source video
expected: Both imported captions appear for editing and export; video export is offered only when a video is present.
